The '''Yusanis' Dueling Shields''' were manufactured [[Personal energy shield/Legends|shields]] that were unmatched on the battlefield. They had to be replaced after five uses. They were named for the [[Echani/Legends|Echani]] [[General/Legends|general]] [[Yusanis]].
